articles.headline: TSMC explores Texas investment to expand U.S. production
articles.summary: TSMC is reported to be considering additional U.S. manufacturing investment, including collaboration possibilities around Musk’s planned chip complex. This is relevant for supply chains because any expansion could affect chip availability, lead times, and sourcing decisions for hardware-dependent businesses.

articles.headline: Tech stocks drop as doubts over AI spending intensify
articles.summary: Technology shares sold off as investors questioned whether massive AI infrastructure spending can generate returns fast enough. The move matters for executives because it signals rising scrutiny of cloud, chip, and AI capital budgets, with potential knock-on effects for vendor pricing, financing, and procurement timing.

articles.headline: Gartner warns $3.5 trillion of AI infrastructure spending could be at write-down risk
articles.summary: Gartner said AI data-center owners may struggle to earn enough revenue to justify planned capital spending through 2030. Business leaders should read this as a warning that AI infrastructure economics may tighten, affecting cloud costs, partner selection, and the pace of enterprise AI adoption.
